instrument: Pending New Mexico air quality permit for the Project Jupiter 2.45 GW fuel-cell power plant
summary: State air quality permitting for the campus's 2.45 GW on-site fuel-cell power plant remains pending. The New Mexico Supreme Court paused the state air quality and water use permitting proceedings before allowing them to continue in September 2026.

source.citation: El Paso Matters; Santa Fe New Mexican, Sept 24-25, 2026

confidence_note: Permit application and court orders not read.
